verdict.rationale: Qdrant ships first-party self-hosting: a documented Docker quickstart, "deploy on any infrastructure" guides, distributed deployment mode, and Private Cloud for any Kubernetes cluster. Independent community reports corroborate this, citing the Apache-2.0 license and building the small portable binaries from source in Rust.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy Qdrant on any infrastructure. Get requirements, configuration options, and GPU setup guides.
Qdrant Private Cloud allows you to manage Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure.
easy to build from source in Rust (~30 min), small portable binaries
Qdrant is an Open-Source Vector Search Engine written in Rust.
